result: In `skid_buffer_core`, replace the 2-bit occupancy count and its case-based state update with two occupancy flags representing nonempty and full, and derive `out_valid` and `in_ready` directly from those flags. Rewrite the sequential transitions for empty, one-item, and full states to preserve the existing push/pop behavior and data0/data1 updates, including simultaneous transfers and stalls. Keep the synchronous active-high reset limited to occupancy state, preserve data-register hold behavior and all ports, and do not change observable cycle behavior or add a latency annotation.
